result.reason: The redline meets the fallback and partially achieves the preferred position: it expressly covers affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to an assuming successor in a genuine M&A transaction. The changes are targeted and preserve the location and fee restrictions. It does not add perpetual/irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences or the required subscription termination standard, so it does not reach the full preferred position. Drafting is generally professional, though retaining “non-transferable” in the grant creates a minor internal tension with the later express transfer right.
